_derivation_note: Hand-derived from an independent re-implementation of the page's stated Planck-function IR-excess model: B_nu(T,nu) (Planck function), F_nu = f*L*B_nu/(4*sigma*T^4*d^2) converted to mJy, orbit radius r = sqrt(L/(4*pi*sigma*T^4)). Detector bands (SPHEREx 3.5um/0.04mJy, SPHEREx 4.5um/0.08mJy, WISE W3 12um/1.0mJy, WISE W4 22um/6.0mJy) taken from the page's own BANDS table (physical constants, not tool output). Verified with an independently-written Node script reproducing all 9 output fields to the tool's own display precision (lam_peak_um to 2dp, orbit_radius_AU to 3dp, fluxes to 4 significant figures via toPrecision(4)) -- see OCS-FIXWAVE.md FW-4 board note. Case 1 uses the page's own default state (f=0.01, T=300K, d=OC distance, L=1 Lsun); case 2 raises the covering fraction to f=0.5 to cross the WISE W3 detection threshold (verdict flips to EXCLUDED).
